text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the blink of an eye, it's already the
holiday
season. I'm heading to my office,
when...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, guess who's in town? It's
Santa, and
you're on his list.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nothin' crazy.
I've got a little surprise for
ya.
You'll see.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Just keep quiet and follow me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The phrasing makes me feel like I'm
gonna get taken 'round back like in her
thug mangas, but
Vodka leads me
straight to my office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We open the door and...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The once plain and boring room is now
covered in
seasonal decorations.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, here you go. It's a little present
from me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What catches my eye the most is the
delectable
spread on the side table.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A glazed roast chicken, a salad shaped
like a
wreath, and an entire strawberry
cake...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Welp, there it is. Go ahead and dig in.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...All homemade. By yours truly.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Y-ya don't gotta be that surprised...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: My mom drilled how to cook into me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She always says that anyone worth their
salt's
gotta be able to cook for
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get a sense of her mother's personality
through
those words. She must be a
good role model for
Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But... i-it's kinda lame...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Uh... well...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that knowing how to cook this
well is
cool, if anything.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I mean. Although, it is
kinda
embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The lame part is me... All this time I knew how to cook, but I never made anything for ya till now.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Naw! Actually, the whole thing's
embarrassing! I can't have people
thinkin' I'm some homemaker!
I'm an
outlaw!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I knew you wouldn't look down on me for it, but still...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Not bein' able to show my true self is
lame.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Making a homemade meal for me must
have been
a battle in itself for Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I-I dunno if you'll like it. Either way,
I'm
not
makin' anythin' else if ya don't.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: H-how do you know that?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You have too much faith in me...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...I guess you're right. We already know
so much
about each other.
choice_data_list: That goes both ways, doesn't it?
That goes both ways, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
We're always so busy, so let's just have
fun
tonight.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Happy holidays, Trainer. Thanks for
everything.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well, let's get to enjoyin' our feast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After eating for a little bit...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If this were before my debut, I'd have
been fine
calling it a night here.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But that's not the case now. Let's head
into town,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
To give out presents to all my fans,
obviously.

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Is that Vodka over there?! It is!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Happy holidays, Vodka! Show us some
love!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sure!
I've got winks and air kisses galore!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Today's a special day, so I came out to
share it
with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyahhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka struts through the cheering
crowd,
embodying the perfect image of
cool.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She moves around town, greeting as
many of her
fans as she can.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Listen, Trainer. That cooking stuff from
earlier
has gotta be kept a secret.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And not 'cause I'm embarrassed! It's
Santa's job to
protect people's dreams
too!
